body:
Grace is teaming up with some good friends to offer a special weekend for women (from any background). If you want to …

 Discover your gifts.

 Empower your soul.

 Love the world.

 … join Grace and friends for a weekend of learning, discovery and connection. Learn a new way of listening to your heart & your stories, so you can experience empathy and courage during changing times.

 October 26 – 29, 2017. Marco Island, Florida

 Spouses, family members, and friends: this could be a great gift to a woman you love!

 For more information and to register, click here.
